purpose: What Microsoft Word shows for REF fields with the \r (relative context) switch when the target or the position has a list level shown at its start value, and in a footnote while a footnote paragraph is numbered, the two cases #1258 refused unmeasured (#1284).
procedure: Each probe `spec` was compiled with generateDocx using the full-context form and every \w instruction rewritten to \r (generation then refused both cases). Word opened each DOCX bound by its name only (staged under a unique name in Word's container, opened with open -g); `update field` ran on every field of the document and of each footnote's text object through AppleScript, and each field's code and result and every paragraph's list label were read back; the document was closed by name without saving. The same DOCX was converted to PDF with headless LibreOffice and read with pdftotext.
finding: Start value: a level shown at its start value takes part in the \r comparison at that value, and the shown number then passes over it as the full number does. From the next clause directly under an Article, 'ARTICLE II(a)' shows '(a)'; from 'Section 4.02(a)', 'ARTICLE IV(i)' shows '(i)' (the start-value Section level equals 1 and Word counts it, so the next Section heading is 4.02); from another Article the full number. A position at a start value compares the same way ('Section 3.01(b)' from 'ARTICLE IV(ii)'). Footnotes: a footnote paragraph numbered by another list leaves every relative field in footnotes at the full number. A footnote paragraph numbered by the target's own list starts that list's count afresh within the footnotes (its label reads '(a)', unaffected by the body) and later footnote fields, the numbered paragraph's own included, are relative to it: 'Section 1.01(a)' shows '(a)' after a footnote '(a)' (levels shown at start value 1.01), while fields before it show the full number. LibreOffice 26.2 differs on both: it shows a start-value level ('Section 2.01(a)' for Word's 'ARTICLE II(a)', '(a)(i)' for '(i)') and shows the full number in every footnote.
generation: With the relativeStartValue refusal removed, generateDocx's cached results equal Word's after-update results for all 47 fields of probe1 and all 30 fields of probe2. probe3 is refused: a relative reference in a footnote to a paragraph of a numbering definition that also numbers a footnote paragraph, because Word measures it from the footnotes' own count of the list, which generation does not model (nor whether that count continues from one footnote to the next).

spec.text: Inserts the entire paragraph number of the bookmarked paragraph in relative context—or relative to its position in the numbering scheme—without trailing periods.

probes.name: probe1-start-value
probes.layout: The heading definition (ARTICLE %1 / Section %1.%2 / (%3) / (%4), headings numbered by style) with levels shown at their start value: two (a)/(b) clauses before any Article (the Article and Section levels at start value; Word then counts the first Article heading as ARTICLE II), clauses directly under an Article (Section level at start value), sub-clauses directly under a Section (clause level at start value), and sub-clauses directly under an Article (Section and clause levels at start value), with fields to them from the same run of clauses, a heading, plain paragraphs, other Sections and other Articles, and from them to ordinary targets.
